n: "PoE Speaker and Microphone Pod with support for DM NAX Intelligent (DM-NAX-POD-MIC-SPK)
d: DM-NAX-POD-MIC-SPK "PoE Speaker and Microphone Pod with support for DM NAX Intelligent Audio

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: For control and PoE, AoIP, and/or console, 100/1000 Mbps, auto-switching, auto-negotiating, auto-discovery, full/half duplex, DHCP

specs.label: DSP
specs.value: Acoustic echo cancellation, automatic gain control, dynamic noise suppression, and speaker volume control Full-duplex IEEE 1329 Type 1 compliant

specs.label: PoE+
specs.value: IEEE 802.3at Class 4 (25.5 W) compliant; Compatible with IEEE 802.3at compliant Ethernet switch or third-party PoE+ compliant PSE

specs.label: Enclosure
specs.value: Lightly textured black finish, plastic housing, perforated stainless steel grilles, and die-cast aluminum bottom cover
